frontmatter.name: Parth Gartan
frontmatter.bio: I am Parth Gartan, a full-stack developer from Chandigarh, India. I work with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js and Go, along with cloud native tools like Docker and Kubernetes. Open source is where I've grown the most as a developer. I enjoy digging into how things work under the hood. Being part of the Layer5 community has shown me how much good mentorship and collaboration can speed up learning, and I'm excited to keep giving back by contributing code, reviewing others' work, and helping new contributors find their footing.
